purpose: Make runtime stability analysis falsifiable, repeatable, multiscale and fail-closed.

evidence_ladder.meaning: A directly measured value or structural delta exists.
The observation recurs across at least three independent captures and an explicit falsifier has been attempted.
Repeated observation co-varies with an outcome and at least two independent source types contribute evidence; causality remains forbidden.
Association also has temporal precedence, explicit falsifier testing and alternative-explanation review.
Causal candidate additionally survives controlled intervention or reversal/reproduction.

baseline.zero_mad_rule: candidate outside observed min/max is deviation, not causality
baseline.independence_rule: input paths, bytes and controller_run_id must be distinct; this proves distinct acquisition events only
baseline.capture_run_rule: each baseline snapshot must carry a distinct controller_run_id
baseline.minimum_independent_snapshots_semantics: legacy field name; distinct captures are repeated measures, not proof of statistical/source independence
baseline.sample_depth_labels: MINIMAL/ROBUST/STRONG describe count depth only, not evidentiary strength or statistical power
baseline.robust_sigma_scale_semantics: NORMAL-CONSISTENCY SCALING FOR MAD; DESCRIPTIVE SCREENING DOES NOT CREATE A P-VALUE

dimensions: capture consistency / module churn during non-atomic snapshot
observation_quality.rule: low-quality or incomparable observations must become TOKEN_VAZIO rather than negative evidence

multiscale_rule: Evidence from one scale cannot promote another scale without an explicit bridge.
alternative_explanations: snapshot race / module churn during capture
same module basename representing different filesystem objects
wall-clock adjustment while monotonic elapsed time remains valid
controller local context differing from remotely attached target context
falsifiability_invariants: same app identity != same process generation
compact fingerprint drift != structural identity drift
causal-support-ready structure != permission to publish a causal claim
observer-visible process state != complete physical process state
distinct observation id != distinct observation evidence
non-empty array != valid structured evidence record

evidence_independence.rule: independent evidence requires distinct independence_group values, not merely distinct labels/source_type strings
evidence_independence.baseline_note: repeated baseline captures may share one instrumentation channel; source independence must be established separately
evidence_independence.observation_repetition: REPEATED and higher require unique observation ids and unique non-empty observation fingerprints
evidence_independence.evidence_reference_rule: association/causal levels require distinct non-empty evidence refs in addition to distinct source_type and independence_group
evidence_independence.structured_record_rule: falsifier, temporal-order, intervention and alternative-explanation records must contain required non-empty semantic fields; empty objects never satisfy a gate

hyperMemory_chain.eviction_rule: if the predecessor cannot be observed after ring eviction, emit TOKEN_VAZIO_EVICTED_PREDECESSOR instead of GENESIS
hyperMemory_chain.chain_claim: payload SHA-256 links are local causal-order evidence, not causal proof

storage.publication: temp + fsync + exclusive hard-link + directory fsync

methodology_gate_can_validate: declared evidence channels are distinct by independence_group
